draftText:
CloudPivot Systems (the "Company") is a London-headquartered vertical SaaS platform for the European freight forwarding industry. The transaction values the Company at an enterprise value of EUR 445 million.

The Company has built strong fundamentals. It serves over 1'200 freight forwarder and customs broker customers across 28 European countries and generates annual recurring revenue (ARR) of EUR 84 million as of October 2025, up from EUR 52 million two years prior. EBITDA margin is 11.1% on trailing twelve months revenue of EUR 76 million. Net revenue retention has averaged 113% over the past 24 months.

The team is led by founder-CEO Mr. Tom Fairfield and CTO Mr. James O'Brien. The Company employs 320 people across offices in London, Hamburg, Lisbon, and Bangalore. It has built a clear competitive lead in the European mid-market against entrenched legacy software competitors.

Our investment thesis rests on three pillars. First, the European freight forwarding software market remains structurally underpenetrated, with approximately 40% of forwarders still on legacy systems or spreadsheets. Second, the Company's vertical product depth creates very high switching costs. Third, the addressable European market of 14'000 forwarders gives meaningful headroom from the Company's current 8.6% penetration.

We project ARR growth from EUR 81 million today to approximately EUR 195 million over a five-year hold, representing 19% CAGR. Our base case generates 2.6x MOIC and 21% gross IRR.

In summary, the Company is a high-quality vertical SaaS asset with a defensible competitive position. The investment fits well with the broader portfolio strategy.
